scientific_integrity: Certified by two standalone exhaustive LCS implementations plus a direct witness checker; no claim of external independent validation or asymptotic improvement.
scientific_limitations: A computer-assisted finite classification at a fixed strict epsilon and ternary alphabet; earlier literature already states the numerical 12/13 lower bound. This finding adds exact terminal length and uniqueness only. Unpublished enumeration priority and independent external audit remain open.
title: A unique maximal ternary synchronization string at the published \(12/13\) benchmark
